cohort: 128 mother-infant pairs from the ALADDIN birth cohort study
finding: Six-month-old infants in anthroposophic families had a significantly higher abundance of Bifidobacterium and lower abundances of Bacteroides and Veillonella in their gut microbiota compared to infants in non-anthroposophic families.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with delayed colonisation of Bifidobacterium and Bacteroides.
